subject.title: fix(codex): prefer recovered replies over stale failure banners

question: Should failed Codex conversation turns be suppressed only when completed assistant-message evidence exists, or may partial streamed deltas also replace the failure banner?
rationale: The code-level repair is clear if completed assistant evidence is required, but accepting delta-only output as a successful recovered reply would intentionally change user-visible failure semantics.

options.title: Require Completed Assistant Evidence
options.body: Track completed `item/completed` or `turn.items` assistant text separately and suppress failed-turn errors only when that completed text exists.

options.title: Accept Partial Delta Recovery
options.body: Allow streamed deltas to replace failed-turn banners, but require explicit maintainer acceptance plus live proof because this can deliver incomplete output.

options.title: Wait For Upstream Signal
options.body: Pause this PR until Codex exposes a clearer recovered-versus-fatal completion signal instead of inferring recovery from text shape.

recommendation.title: Require Completed Assistant Evidence
recommendation.body: Track completed `item/completed` or `turn.items` assistant text separately and suppress failed-turn errors only when that completed text exists.

likelyOwner.reason: Most directly tied to Codex app-server protocol and recent binding behavior history.
